messages.subject: [Epls-r-users] R group this Friday!
messages.body_plain:
Good morning everyone!

We will have our next meeting of the R group this Friday at noon in Stone G158 or zoom (https://fsu.zoom.us/j/97381084243<https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Ffsu.zoom.us%2Fj%2F97381084243&data=05%7C02%7Cepls-r-users%40lists.fsu.edu%7Ccafcef16681c4896e8f708dce2ec8993%7Ca36450ebdb0642a78d1b026719f701e3%7C0%7C0%7C638634752757123989%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=5YdqxXKWbG%2B2MS7lqT0a%2FxBoKUSxKrSVXguFDVbrjK0%3D&reserved=0>).  We will be talking about package development in R.  Even if you don't plan on building your own package, it can be really helpful to understand the process if you ever need to troubleshoot packages as a user.

I hope to see many of you there!



Kari Roberts

Director of Strategic Planning and Assessment

Division of Student Affairs

Florida State University

313 Westcott Building

Tallahassee, FL 32306-1340
